Method of Attack: Spearphishing campaign delivering custom malware via Google Drive links
Downloading compressed files (RAR, ZIP, JAR) containing malware
DLL side-loading after launching executables in archives
Use of fake emails in 'To' header and real victims in 'CC' header to evade detection
Persistence via registry keys and scheduled tasks (PubLoad)
Obfuscation to evade detection and establish persistence (ToneIns)
Code flow obfuscation and anti-sandbox mechanisms (ToneShell)
Attack Vector: Spearphishing emails with Google Drive or Dropbox links
Indicators of Compromise: Google Drive and Dropbox links delivering malware
Compressed files (RAR, ZIP, JAR) containing malware
Emails with fake 'To' header and real victims in 'CC' header
